evidence.baseline: Sardex is not a token-based currency or a cryptocurrency ... Sardex is not coherence-as-capital. It is not a system for measuring inner states or rewarding presence.
evidence.shipped: Sardex is neither a token-based currency nor a cryptocurrency ... Sardex is neither coherence-as-capital nor a system for measuring inner states or rewarding presence.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.3, false antithesis, and house style.
findings.diagnosis: Neither and nor presents two options as a matched pair the reader might have been choosing between. The baseline's two sentences are two different disavowals aimed at two different readers: one who has been told this is a cryptocurrency, and one who has been reading this book and might think Sardex is an instance of its own proposal. Merging them implies the two misreadings are versions of each other. The second merge is the costlier one, because Sardex is not coherence-as-capital is the sentence that keeps the book's own concept out of the example.

findings.summary: A cleft summarizing what the two examples prove was flattened, and the summary lost its scope.

evidence.baseline: None of them are the answer to civilizational coordination at planetary scale. What they demonstrate is that the design space is real ... and that the failure mode for most attempts is not collapse but the inability to scale beyond founding conditions.
evidence.shipped: None answers civilizational coordination at planetary scale. Together, they show that the design space is real ... and that most attempts fail by being unable to scale beyond their founding conditions rather than by collapsing outright.

findings.diagnosis: What they demonstrate is bounds the claim to what the evidence supports, which is the paragraph's whole discipline after conceding that both examples are imperfect and partial. Together, they show adds a collective the baseline does not claim, since the point is that each example demonstrates this separately. The final clause also reverses a not-X-but-Y into a by-X-rather-than-Y, which buries the surprising half: the failure mode is not collapse, and collapse is what a reader expects.

findings.summary: A paired the work is not and the work is was split, and the denial was moved to the end of the paragraph.

evidence.baseline: This is useful information for any serious project of regenerative economics. The work is not to invent a single new currency that will replace extractive accounting. The work is to build coordination infrastructures in which many currencies can move
evidence.shipped: Any serious project of regenerative economics can learn from this. The work is to build coordination infrastructures in which many currencies can move ... No single new currency will replace extractive accounting.

findings.diagnosis: R-NEGATION-STACK addresses denials stacked before a claim, and one denial immediately answered is the form it endorses. Moving the denial after the claim does not remove it; it converts it from a correction the writer makes to a prediction the writer asserts. No single new currency will replace extractive accounting is a much stronger claim than the work is not to invent one, because the first says it cannot happen and the second says the work is not aimed there. The paragraph also now ends on a negative prediction rather than on the pathways their respective communities require, which is the concrete beat R-LAND wants.

findings.summary: Small qualifiers were removed from the Mondragón and Sardex accounts, each of which was doing evidentiary work.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.21 read onto actually and all.
findings.diagnosis: All the pressures any business faces concedes the full case against the example, which is what earns the But that follows. Removing both leaves a concession and a conclusion with no adversative between them. Between workers, firms, and communities names three pairwise relations; among names one group. And what it can actually do distinguishes capability from ambition, which is the sentence's subject.

regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. F3 names a move that recurs in this batch and is worth stating as a habit: the pass repeatedly relocated a denial from before its correction to after it. In every instance the relocation strengthened the denial, because a denial that answers an expectation is bounded by the expectation, and a denial that stands alone at the end of a paragraph is a verdict. Where R-NEGATION-STACK asks for the denials to go, the pass moved them, and the result claimed more than the baseline did.
